es.example: Con el ruido de la fiesta no pegué ojo en toda la noche.
es.exampleTranslation: With the noise from the party I didn't sleep a wink.

it.example: Ero così agitato che non ho chiuso occhio.
it.exampleTranslation: I was so anxious I didn't sleep a wink.

bridge.note: Both are negative-polarity idioms: they exist only in the negative. You cannot 'pegar ojo' affirmatively.

interference.es_to_it: 'Non attaccare occhio' — pegar is glue/stick, but Italian closes the eye: non chiudere occhio.
interference.it_to_es: 'No cerrar ojo' is understood but isn't the fixed form. Spanish sticks: no pegar ojo.
